Information about my dissertation defense.

Event Details

Date and Time
  15 August 2025 10 AM — 1 PM EST (~3h)

Online Location
  https://augusta-edu.zoom.us/j/97369163776

Physical location
  Dr. Roscoe Williams Ballroom
  Room 155, Jaguar Student Activities Center (JSAC)
  Summerville Campus
  Augusta University
  Campus map

Announcement
  Defense announcement

Committee

  • Clément Aubert, major advisor, Augusta University
  • Martin Avanzini, Centre Inria d’Université Côte d’Azur, France
  • Yuyan Bao, Augusta University
  • Bogdan Chlebus, Augusta University
  • Harley Eades III, Augusta University

Dissertation Documents

See this page →

Timeline & Progress

Responsible or involved party
[A] = advisor   [C] = committee   [S] = student   [T] = The Graduate School (TGS)

Date (2025) Description
✔️ January [T] Approval for alternative template
✔️ March 4 [S] Deadline to submit "Graduation Application Form"
✔️ April [S+A+C+T] Schedule Defense
✔️  • April 6 • [C] With committee members
✔️  • April 7 • [C+T] Submit "Faculty Agreement Form"
✔️  • April 18 • [S] Room reservation
✔️ May 5 [S] Submit dissertation draft to Major Advisor
✔️ July 3 [S] A practice defense talk at a doctoral symposium
✔️ July 8 [A] Approval of draft by Major Advisor
✔️ July 9 [S] Submit dissertation draft to the Advisory Committee
✔️ August 1 [S] Submit to The Graduate School min. 2 weeks before defense
✔️  • July 24 • [C] Signed "Dissertation Approval Form"
✔️  • July 24 • [S] Electronic copy of the Defense Announcement
✔️  • August 1 • [S] Corrected printed hard copy electronic dissertation draft
✔️ July 31 [S] Defense announcement minimally to faculty and students
✔️ August 8 [S] Enroll and pay for fall semester
✔️ August 15 [S+A+C] Oral Defense
✔️  • August 15 • [C] complete and submit to TGS "Final Oral Examination Form"
✔️ September [S+A+T] Complete at least 1 week before graduation
✔️  • August 9 • [S] Complete Graduate Questionnaire
✔️  • August 18 • [S+A+T] Submit "ETD Submission for Publication Approval"
✔️  • August 16 • [S] "Survey of Earned Doctorates" (online)
✔️  • August 26 • [S+T] Exit interview
✔️  • September 19 • [S+T] Submit electronic version of final corrected dissertation
✔️  • September 19 • [S] Submit dissertation to ProQuest (also to HAL)
October 13 The dissertation was approved for publication at ProQuest
October 18 Published on ProQuest
December 9 Published on HAL

Timeline compiled from the various documents below.
